items.notes: Discusses relative-error convergence and instability, but not the near-zero-mean denominator; supporting context only.
Chapter-purpose context on input uncertainty versus sampling error; does not state when a converged run still cannot support a decision.
Covers what validation gates do not establish; no reverse-index semantics or treatment of a pattern mentioned by a decision.
Five separate evidence layers explicitly distinguish engine verification from decision support.
Defines measured and assumed input statuses, but does not address confidence intervals across synthetic replications.
Lists constraint types recorded in decision validity, but not how failed hard constraints differ from soft preferences.
Shows same workload, duration and replications plus normalized per-success metrics across candidates with different server counts.
Provenance and replay-as-new-activity context; does not state what happens to the old derived record when inputs change.
Generic control-responsibility table from another volume; does not describe V12 engine behavior at admission limits.
Worked event sequence shows stale timeout and completion events ignored, preventing a second server release.
